From: Samir Rao <samir@oryon.ai>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 10 Jul 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Production regression after v3.1 quant profile (urgent)

Dylan —

We rolled v3.1 (quant profile v1a) through last night following the guidance from Redwood. Within the first hour we saw P95 latency go from ~210ms to ~510ms, error rate (5xx/timeout) spike from 0.4% to 3.7%, and two customer-visible cases of answer drift/hallucination on intent classification. Our traffic is steady; attached are the first-hour telemetry CSV and representative logs (customer-logs-20250710.zip).

This is customer-impacting for our top 3 merchants. We need an immediate remediation plan and a rollback option. Please escalate to your engineering leadership — our CTO is pinging mine.

Samir
VP Product, Oryon AI

Attachments: v3.1-performance-metrics.csv (CSV), customer-logs-20250710.zip (zip)

Summary of quick triage (first-pass):
- Telemetry: p95 doubled on GPU-backed clusters serving v3.1. We see a 28% increase in KV cache miss ratio for long-tail prefixes vs baseline (likely due to altered tokenization boundaries after quant).
- Kernel/ops: Profiling shows a shift to smaller matmul kernels with higher dispatch overhead under current batch sizing; combined with the cache churn this matches the observed latency jump.
- Errors: Increased decode timeouts correlate with queueing on a specific pod pool; 5xx traces show OOM-killed retries in 2 instances (under investigation).

Immediate mitigation plan (recommended):
1) Route Oryon traffic to the v3.0 model variant (non-quant) using routing policy override. This is reversible and low-risk.
2) If override is not accepted by Oryon, execute a controlled rollback of the model pack for their tenant (we can rollback per-tenant).
3) Forensic artifacts: we need the profiler traces for the v3.1 instances (L0/L1 dumps) and the full logs (they attached a zip — please confirm hashes). We've requested kernel debug artifacts from runtime team.
4) Short-term capacity: consider placement on a larger dedicated pool or temporarily increase concurrency limits to reduce queuing while we remediate.

I will queue a rollback playbook and a runbook for routing override in the 09:15 notes. If Oryon requests credits, product/legal should be looped for the official calculation (Ben/Kimberly).

Next steps: Stand-up at 09:15, then immediate routing change if Oryon approves.

— Irene
Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
From: Samir Rao <samir@oryon.ai>

Dylan / team —

Thanks for the quick triage. We approved routing to v3.0 for all production traffic at 11:30 PT yesterday and saw P95 return to ~220ms. Two asks from Oryon now that traffic is stable:

1) Formal rollback confirmation and a timeline for when v3.1 will be safe to reattempt (we need a postmortem and a remediation plan before any redeploy).
2) Requesting a preliminary SLA credit estimate for the incident window (we've attached a short doc with their ask). Our CTO Jenna is copied here — she wants exec-level confirmation within 48 hours.

Please confirm owners for the postmortem and when engineering expects a full RCA. If possible, include the proposed changes to quantization profiling and a test plan (prefix-heavy synthetic load + tokenization delta checks).

Samir
VP Product, Oryon AI
